scope: deployment design, current status, and test documentation

findings.finding: The earlier E3f-1 review did not cover the new deployment rehearsal.
findings.resolution: Removed that review from this delivery's evidence; this module received a separate review.

findings.finding: Resource preparation records were not linked to the loaded plan.
findings.resolution: Both prepare and check plan IDs must match the loaded plan.

findings.finding: The resource budget report needed stronger integrity checks.
findings.resolution: Pinned and checked its digest, status, target, budget, candidate package evidence, and device-write flags.

findings.finding: Skipped tests could still count as a passing validation.
findings.resolution: The validation gate requires all 19 tests and zero skips.
